entries.1dd58cd998c53e3c: It purchases branded goods, precious metals, gemstones, antiques and art objects from individual customers. In Japan, purchasing is mainly done in-store at "NAMBOYA", "BRAND CONCIER" and "Kobijutsu Hakkodo" stores, and it also offers home-delivery purchasing, on-site purchasing and online purchasing. Overseas, purchasing is done at "ALLU"; as of August 31, 2025, the number of purchasing stores was 139 in Japan and 49 overseas.
entries.32c8c750f5e5fe27: It is expanding its handling of physical assets, including purchase, sale and maintenance of automobiles and real estate brokerage. It is also expanding its repair services.
entries.3873480946e15e3f: Precious metals such as gold and platinum, and products not suited to its own auctions or retail sales, are sold wholesale to businesses that specialize in handling them.
entries.65af1c9f7dc020fc: A single-segment business centered on the purchase and sale of branded goods, precious metals, gemstones, antiques and art objects. Valuence Holdings is a holding company; its domestic business is carried out by its core subsidiary Valuence Japan, while seven overseas subsidiaries purchase and sell products overseas. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥84,841 million.
entries.88fcf058a9c602c0: Branded goods, antiques and art objects reuse business
entries.b174fcde953de00f: A holding company in the reuse business that purchases branded goods, precious metals, antiques and artworks, and sells them through its own auctions, retail stores and EC sites.
entries.b3ae4ab60ccf61af: Through the retail brand "ALLU", it sells vintage and antique products to general consumers. In Japan it has five stores in Ginza, Omotesando, Shinjuku and Shinsaibashi, and it also sells through its own EC site "ALLU online store" and cross-border EC.
entries.caf2acf6d3967a61: It sells purchased products to reuse businesses in Japan and overseas through its own auctions. Besides "STAR BUYERS AUCTION", which targets branded goods, it operates a diamond-only auction held in Hong Kong, "THE EIGHT AUCTION" for antiques and art objects, and "ALLU AUCTION" for general consumers. It also accepts consignment listings of products from partners.
